509:t_102:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「For once, I'm grateful for your perceptiveness, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

509:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You should be able to feel my heart too! Then...」

509:t_102:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll hear the rest once this battle is over!」

509:t_102:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Here I come, $$カミーユ$$! Show me the power $$シャア$$ placed his hopes in!」

509:t_103:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it comes to this after all, $$ハマーン$$.」

509:t_103:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「A man like you couldn't understand my feelings, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

509:t_103:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wonder. I don't think being drawn to him has anything to do with being a man or a woman.」

509:t_103:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you claim to understand me, then you will indulge me.」

509:t_103:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Very well. Just as he became a stronger man by abandoning his fixation on me...」

509:t_103:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll sever your fixation on him, and have you use your talents to follow the right path!」

509:t_103:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You talk big! But that's what I'd expect from $$シャア$$'s lifelong rival!」

509:t_104:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ハマーン$$! Why would someone like you give up on understanding others!?」

509:t_104:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Let me teach you, $$イノベイター$$. Understanding each other doesn't mean there will be no fighting.」

509:t_104:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know that! But nothing can begin without understanding each other!」

509:t_104:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「So, $$ハマーン$$! Tell us how you feel... And tell Colonel $$シャア$$!」

509:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I intend to, without being told...! But I won't do it through words!」

509:t_104:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then come! I'll feel who you are through this battle!」

509:t_105:0.en:
$$シン$$
「I've had enough of you! If that's what you want, I'll fight you!」

509:t_105:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's fine, boy. I prefer it to hearing clumsy words strung together.」

509:t_105:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Then I'll do it! I'll beat you down so thoroughly here that you'll never think of attacking us again!」

509:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you can do that, I'll accept you as worthy of $$シャア$$ staking everything on!」

509:t_106:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Your feelings give you strength...! But they're far too sad!」

509:t_106:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You talk as if you understand!」

509:t_106:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I can't know what's inside your heart...! But I know you mustn't keep fighting with such sad feelings!」

509:t_106:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then try to stop me, if you can!」

509:t_106:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「I will! I have feelings and strength too!」

509:t_107:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Say nothing, $$マリーダ$$. I do understand how you feel.」

509:t_107:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... I suppose $$シャア$$ is to me what $$ジンネマン$$ is to you.」

509:t_107:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But Master respects my will. And surely the Colonel would respect your...」

509:t_107:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's enough, $$マリーダ$$. I'm here to find that out.」

509:t_107:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then I'll fight you to help you cast aside your doubts!」

509:t_108:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ハマーン$$! I won't give the Colonel to someone like you!」

509:t_108:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You little girl! $$シャア$$ led you astray, and now you fight for $c!?」

509:t_108:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's right, because I believe in what the Colonel does 100%!」

509:t_108:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「I won't lose to someone like you who finds all sorts of excuses to reject the Colonel!」

509:t_108:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's precisely why I fight, to shake off $$シャア$$'s shadow too!」

509:t_108:8.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'll fight you, $$ハマーン$$! But I absolutely won't lose!」

509:t_109:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I heard the reports, but to think you would join $c.」

509:t_109:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have no intention of hiding it now. This is the way of life I chose.」

509:t_109:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've already stopped chasing after the Colonel.」

509:t_109:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm the same, $$ギュネイ$$.」

509:t_109:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's why I must fight you, to find out what $c, which that man staked everything on, really is!」

509:t_110:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I've confirmed the target. My attack target is $$ハマーン・カーン$$.」

509:t_110:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's right. Come at me with all your strength.」

509:t_110:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't misunderstand, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. We're not the ones who will settle things with you.」

509:t_110:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We're merely filling in until $$シャア・アズナブル$$ returns.」

509:t_111:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...! I'll stop you!」

509:t_111:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're the woman I fought during the $$多元戦争$$...! It seems your skills have improved!」

509:t_111:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I may not win one-on-one... But I can't leave someone fighting with hesitation alone!」

509:t_111:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This unit has a lot of busybodies.」

509:t_111:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But perhaps that's what drew that man to you too...」

509:t_112:0.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. I don't have the luxury of worrying about you like $$カミーユ$$ and the others.」

509:t_112:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's just what I want. My warrior's blood is stirring for the first time in a while...!」

509:t_112:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Show me your power, boy! I'll see whether you're strong enough for $$シャア$$ to entrust his hopes to!」

509:t_113:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ハマーン・カーン$$! I'll end your lives with my scorpion's poison!」

509:t_113:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! Understand that people can't live on hatred alone!」

509:t_113:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think words like that can erase the memory of fire within me!」

509:t_114:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n! I'll be taking your $$ジェミニオン$$!」

509:t_114:1.en:
$n
「Do you think I'll just say 'Sure' and hand it over?」

509:t_114:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're awfully bold without $$アムブリエル$$ here.」

509:t_114:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Give up already. That woman... She'll merge soon, and your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ will disappear completely.」

509:t_114:5.en:
$n
「I won't let that happen...! There's no way I'll let you!」

509:t_115:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you think this kind of fighting will make $$オードリー$$ happy!?」

509:t_115:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You worry about $$ミネバ$$ even when your own life is in danger.」

509:t_115:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Or do you think you can defeat me?」

509:t_115:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll... protect the $$ユニコーン$$, whatever happens...! It's the possibility $$オードリー$$ entrusted to me!」

509:t_115:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Very well. Consider this my thanks for protecting $$ミネバ$$ all this time.」

509:t_115:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll show you how a warrior lives!」
